I can't give you an amount for beta-alanine, or any supplement. In general terms, it's one of the more studied ones, mostly for efforts lasting roughly one to four minutes, and it can cause a harmless-feeling tingling sensation in some people. Whether it's worth taking and how much is a question for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can account for your health and what else you take.

If you tell me what you're training for, I can talk about what moves the needle on the training side.
